data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a prior year reserve strengthening of USD 11.224 million, primarily driven by adverse development on the 2017 and 2018 underwriting years as calculated from the claims development triangle. Narrative mentions a prior year adverse movement on the 2017 AXA/XL Whole Account Quota Share contract and upward reassessment of casualty loss ratios for the 2019 year of account, partly due to Typhoon Hagibis. Other factors influencing reserve estimates include economic and social inflation, and reliance on external data for certain contracts.
